headlines.title: Voters making final decisions in midterm elections
headlines.description: Voters across the U.S. are making their choices in the midterm elections as those competing for their vote make their final pitches.

headlines.title: NBC News Exit Poll: How it works and how we use the results on election night
headlines.description: Before votes are tallied on election night, exit polls offer an early look at who is voting and what is motivating their choices.
headlines.source: Stephanie Perry, NBC News Exit Poll Desk

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: U.S. military carries out limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island
headlines.description: The strikes, which appeared to be limited as opposed to a full return to hostilities, came on the eve of crucial American midterm elections.

headlines.title: Co-pilot and passengers killed in learjet crash identified
headlines.description: A family on a trip to the Bahamas and a 20-year-old pilot are among the nine people killed when a Learjet crashed in Florida over the weekend. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports from the scene of the crash.

headlines.title: New York reports first measles death in more than 30 years
headlines.description: So far this year, the state has reported 178 measles cases.

headlines.title: With AO3 down, fanfic readers are in survival mode
headlines.description: When the internet’s biggest fanfiction repository vanishes from reach, there’s one thing you can still count on: a network of fellow fans.
